snippet.title: REKT! High Octane Stunts - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
REKT! is a stunt, driving game inspired by the eternal classics like Rush and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater series. In quick gameplay sessions, you will complete various challenges to unlock cars, arenas, and customizations.
Do outstanding tricks and stunts to get the highest scores and face other players - rule the leaderboard!
The physics model in REKT makes performing tricks incredibly smooth and easy but don’t get too comfortable - it's easy to learn but hard to master.

Published by No Gravity Games S.A.
Developed by Little Chicken Game Company
Also released for Nintendo Switch, Android, Xbox One and PC
